Team —

Quick reminder: today is the weekly forecast submission window and the precall with Aurelia is at 12:30 PT. Please do the following before the 11:30 PT checkpoint: 

- Update stage and commit signals for any deals you own in the pipeline spreadsheet (probabilities, next steps, blockers).
- If a deal is moving to commit, add expected close date + any I&O that would be needed for Dedicated or Private.
- Attach a single PDF version of your one-page account summary to the thread (deck or bullets).

Marissa — can you take the lead on the 12:30 precall slide deck and call script? I will run the 11:30 internal sync and surface any asks. Neha — please refresh the pipeline snapshot and flag any accounts that need escalation or security review.

Agenda for the internal 11:30 sync (30 min):
1) Quick pass: top 5 commit candidates (2 min each)
2) Escalations: security/procurement holds
3) Calendar/handoff: who is on the external call and speaking order
4) Last-minute pricing/discount asks

Attachments: I uploaded a starter agenda and the previous week's deck as attachments (see below).

Thanks — see you on the sync.

—Markus
